entities.name: Asenue
entities.description: An Amonkheti warrior and master blademaster who fought to the last during the Final Hours, later part of the Dreadhorde.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Phyrexian-aligned horde on Ravnica Asenue joined as undead.

events.summary: During the Hour of Eternity Asenue fought two Eternals on the streets of Naktamun, knowing she would lose.
events.quote: Asenue faced two Eternals in a desperate battle on the streets of Naktamun

events.summary: Asenue became part of the Dreadhorde on Ravnica and was re-killed by Samut.
events.quote: She became part of the Dreadhorde on Ravnica and was re-killed by Samut

relations.note: Killed her after she joined the Dreadhorde.
